entries.en: The owners plan to air-condition the upstairs bedrooms before next summer.
entries.zh: 业主计划在明年夏天前给楼上的卧室安装空调。

entries.en: The remote weather station runs on solar power during the summer months.
entries.zh: 夏季的几个月里，这座偏远气象站靠太阳能运行。

entries.en: The table of contents directed me to the chapter on coastal erosion.
entries.zh: 目录指引我找到了关于海岸侵蚀的章节。

entries.en: A retired factory worker showed the museum visitors how the loom operated.
entries.zh: 一位退休工厂工人向博物馆参观者演示了织布机如何运转。

entries.en: The children began to draw close when the storyteller lowered her voice.
entries.zh: 讲故事的人压低声音时，孩子们开始靠拢。

entries.en: I missed the reunion because I happened to catch cold that weekend.
entries.zh: 我错过了聚会，因为那个周末恰好感冒了。

entries.en: The simulation failed because the available computer memory could not hold the data.
entries.zh: 模拟失败了，因为可用的计算机存储器装不下这些数据。

entries.en: His good humor survived even the long queue outside the ticket office.
entries.zh: 即使售票处外排着长队，他仍然心情很好。

entries.en: The mechanic recognised the distinctive fins on the air-cooled engine.
entries.zh: 机修工认出了这台气冷式发动机上独特的散热片。

entries.en: The carpenter stacked the air-dried boards against the workshop wall.
entries.zh: 木匠把风干的木板堆放在车间墙边。

entries.en: The relief agency arranged to air-drop food to villages cut off by flooding.
entries.zh: 救援机构安排向被洪水隔绝的村庄空投食品。

entries.en: The astronomy worksheet asked us to compare a sidereal year with a tropical year.
entries.zh: 天文学练习要求我们比较恒星年和回归年。

entries.en: The manufacturer kept the glaze recipe as a closely guarded trade secret.
entries.zh: 制造商将釉料配方作为严加保守的商业秘密。

entries.en: The teacher marked the word accent above the second syllable.
entries.zh: 老师在第二个音节上方标出了单词重音。

entries.en: The historian examined how law merchant shaped disputes between medieval traders.
entries.zh: 历史学家研究了商人习惯法如何影响中世纪商人之间的纠纷。

entries.en: The curator pointed out the great seal attached to the royal document.
entries.zh: 馆长指出了附在王室文件上的国玺。

entries.en: The sculpture was air-dry, although its thicker base still felt cool.
entries.zh: 这座雕塑已经晾干，但较厚的底座摸起来仍然发凉。

entries.en: The fragile instrument travelled inside an air-filled protective sleeve.
entries.zh: 这件易碎仪器装在充气保护套内运送。

entries.en: A gust from the open window scattered the sheet music across the stage.
entries.zh: 敞开的窗户吹来一阵风，把活页乐谱吹散在舞台上。

entries.en: The mechanic arrived in the nick of time to stop the leaking pipe.
entries.zh: 机修工恰好及时赶到，制止了管道漏水。

entries.en: The hard right opposed the compromise announced by the party leadership.
entries.zh: 极右派反对该党领导层宣布的妥协方案。

entries.en: The magazine's feature article followed a beekeeper through an entire harvesting season.
entries.zh: 这本杂志的专题文章跟踪记录了一名养蜂人整个采收季的经历。

entries.en: The instruction book explained which attachments fitted the older sewing machine.
entries.zh: 说明书解释了哪些附件适用于那台旧缝纫机。

entries.en: The road gang paused while a herd of sheep crossed the unfinished road.
entries.zh: 一群羊穿过尚未完工的道路时，筑路队暂停了工作。

entries.en: The technician adjusted the scale's zero point before weighing the samples.
entries.zh: 技术员在称量样本前调整了秤的零点。

entries.en: Leaves had blocked the engine's air-intake during the autumn storm.
entries.zh: 秋季风暴期间，树叶堵住了发动机的进气孔。

entries.en: He balanced a hot dog and a drink while searching for his stadium seat.
entries.zh: 他一边拿稳热狗和饮料，一边寻找自己在体育场的座位。

entries.en: The old cardboard box began to fall apart when we lifted it.
entries.zh: 我们抬起那个旧纸箱时，它开始散架。

entries.en: Early frost delayed play on the golf course beside the lake.
entries.zh: 晨霜推迟了湖边高尔夫球场的比赛。

entries.en: The settlers had to hew out a clearing before building their cabin.
entries.zh: 定居者必须先砍出一片空地，才能建造小屋。

entries.en: The ferry's sister ship entered service six months after the first vessel.
entries.zh: 这艘渡轮的同型船在首艘船投入使用六个月后开始运营。

entries.en: The council restricted commercial activity in the park during the nesting season.
entries.zh: 市政委员会在筑巢季限制了公园内的商业活动。

entries.en: The orange air-sleeve hung limp beside the runway on the windless morning.
entries.zh: 无风的清晨，橙色风向袋软垂在跑道旁。

entries.en: The laboratory stored the powder in an air-tight container with a rubber seal.
entries.zh: 实验室将粉末储存在带橡胶密封圈的气密容器中。

entries.en: The museum's display compared air-to-air weapons from several periods of aviation history.
entries.zh: 博物馆的展陈比较了航空史上几个时期的空对空武器。

entries.en: The missing key seemed to have vanished into thin air.
entries.zh: 丢失的钥匙似乎消失得无影无踪。

entries.en: The prospectors hit pay dirt when an abandoned claim yielded commercially valuable gold.
entries.zh: 一处废弃矿权地出产了具有商业价值的黄金，勘探者有了能获利的发现。

entries.en: The case study traced the small firm's recovery after its largest customer left.
entries.zh: 这项案例研究追踪了这家小公司在最大客户离开后的复苏过程。

entries.en: Residents gathered outside the town hall before the planning committee's meeting.
entries.zh: 规划委员会开会前，居民聚集在市政厅外。

entries.en: The museum moved unused display stands into a locked storage room.
entries.zh: 博物馆把闲置展架搬进了一间上锁的库房。

entries.en: The carpenter used a match plane to prepare the edges of the floorboards.
entries.zh: 木匠用合榫刨加工地板木条的边缘。

entries.en: The archive contained photographs of early air-to-ground reconnaissance equipment and weapons.
entries.zh: 档案中有早期空对地侦察设备和武器的照片。

entries.en: The exhibition label identified the object as an experimental air-to-surface weapon.
entries.zh: 展览标签将该物件标为一种试验性空对地面武器。

entries.en: The aircraftman wrote home about his first week at the RAF base.
entries.zh: 这名空军士兵在家书中讲述了自己在英国皇家空军基地的第一周。

entries.en: The lecturer questioned the term safe period in a historical fertility leaflet.
entries.zh: 讲师质疑了一份历史生育宣传单中使用的“安全期”一词。

entries.en: Thick oil paint clung to the artist's palette knife after the session.
entries.zh: 作画结束后，厚厚的油画颜料粘在画家的调色刀上。

entries.en: On this diagram, due east occupies the rightmost point of the compass.
entries.zh: 在这张图上，正东位于罗盘最右侧的位置。

entries.en: The unexpected resignation was a dramatic event in the club's quiet history.
entries.zh: 这次意外辞职是该俱乐部平静历史中的一个戏剧性事件。

entries.en: She published detective stories under a pen name while teaching mathematics.
entries.zh: 她一边教数学，一边用笔名发表侦探小说。

entries.en: The aircraftsman appeared in a photograph taken outside the RAF barracks.
entries.zh: 这名空军士兵出现在一张在英国皇家空军营房外拍摄的照片中。

entries.en: An aircrewman checked the passenger list before the helicopter departed.
entries.zh: 直升机出发前，一名空勤组员核对了乘客名单。

entries.en: The crew counted the emergency supplies stored inside the life raft.
entries.zh: 船员清点了救生筏内存放的应急物资。

entries.en: The island treats fresh water as a precious natural resource.
entries.zh: 这座岛将淡水视为珍贵的自然资源。

entries.en: The annoyed caretaker told the noisy visitors to shove off.
entries.zh: 恼火的看守叫那些吵闹的访客滚开。

entries.en: One great grandparent appears in the oldest photograph in our family album.
entries.zh: 我们家相册中最早的一张照片里有一位曾祖辈亲人。

entries.en: The fatigue party spent the afternoon carrying supplies into the barracks.
entries.zh: 杂役队整个下午都在往营房搬运物资。

entries.en: The new tram connects this city district with the university campus.
entries.zh: 新电车线路把这片市区与大学校园连接起来。

entries.en: The abandoned airdrome still had its control tower and two rusting hangars.
entries.zh: 这座废弃机场仍保留着控制塔和两个生锈的机库。

entries.en: They had to airfreight the replacement pump to the isolated research station.
entries.zh: 他们不得不将替换用的泵空运到孤立的研究站。

entries.en: Her course in ancient history focused on trade across the Mediterranean.
entries.zh: 她的古代史课程重点研究地中海地区的贸易。

entries.en: The diagram shows pressure feed carrying oil from the pump to the bearings.
entries.zh: 图中展示了润滑油通过压力输送从泵流向轴承的过程。

entries.en: A single candle illuminated the painting in the side chapel.
entries.zh: 一支蜡烛照亮了附属礼拜堂里的画作。

entries.en: The orchestra followed the composer's unusual stage directions to the letter.
entries.zh: 乐团不折不扣地遵循了作曲家不同寻常的舞台指示。

entries.en: The vocational school offered evening classes in plumbing and electrical installation.
entries.zh: 这所职业学校开设了管道安装和电气安装的夜间课程。

entries.meaningZh: 两面皆可推拉开关的门
entries.en: A waiter pushed through the swing door carrying a tray of empty glasses.
entries.zh: 服务员端着一盘空杯子，推开双向门走了过去。

entries.en: The installation used transparent fabric to create an almost airlike curtain.
entries.zh: 这件装置艺术用透明织物做出了一幅几乎像空气一样的帘幕。

entries.en: The instructor praised her airmanship after a difficult landing in gusty conditions.
entries.zh: 在阵风中完成一次困难的降落后，教练称赞了她的飞行技术。

entries.en: A distant range of mountains remained white with snow throughout June.
entries.zh: 远处的一条山脉整个六月都覆着白雪。

entries.en: The probe continued into deep space after passing the outer planets.
entries.zh: 探测器经过外侧行星后继续飞向深空。

entries.en: The compiler manual identifies assembly as the object language for this translation stage.
entries.zh: 编译器手册将汇编语言指定为这一转换阶段的目标语言。

entries.en: The children wanted to muck about by the stream all afternoon.
entries.zh: 孩子们想整个下午都在小溪边闲玩。

entries.en: The judge explained the legal principle behind the decision in plain language.
entries.zh: 法官用通俗的语言解释了裁决背后的法律原则。

entries.en: She found a pressed flower between the pages of her mother's prayer book.
entries.zh: 她在母亲祈祷书的书页间发现了一朵压干的花。

entries.en: The shelter asked visitors to donate unopened tins of cat food.
entries.zh: 收容所请访客捐赠未开封的罐装猫粮。

entries.en: The wartime letter bore a stamp showing it had travelled by airpost.
entries.zh: 这封战时信件盖着邮戳，表明它是通过航空邮递运送的。

entries.en: The restored aircraft's wooden airscrew was polished for the museum opening.
entries.zh: 为了博物馆开幕，这架修复后的飞机的木制螺旋桨被擦亮了。

entries.en: The airwoman described her first solo flight to an attentive school audience.
entries.zh: 这位女飞行员向专注聆听的学校听众讲述了她的首次单人飞行。

entries.en: The cobbler replaced the worn top lift on the heel of my shoe.
entries.zh: 修鞋匠换掉了我鞋跟上磨损的天皮。

entries.en: Months of red tape delayed permission to repair the village bridge.
entries.zh: 数月繁琐的行政程序耽误了村桥维修许可的发放。

entries.en: Through the telescope, the double star resolved into two distinct points of light.
entries.zh: 通过望远镜，那颗双星分辨为两个清楚的光点。

entries.en: Please do more than skim over the report before tomorrow's discussion.
entries.zh: 明天讨论之前，请不要只是草草浏览这份报告。

entries.en: The chapter examines the privileges enjoyed by the second estate before the French Revolution.
entries.zh: 这一章探讨了法国大革命前贵族阶层享有的特权。

entries.en: The novel reveals that the two characters once had a sexual relationship.
entries.zh: 小说揭示了这两个人物曾经有过性关系。

entries.en: The maritime historian noted that the chart used a sea mile of six thousand feet.
entries.zh: 海事史学家指出，这张海图使用的是六千英尺一海里的旧制单位。

entries.en: The butcher set aside an aitchbone for the inn's Sunday roast.
entries.zh: 肉贩为客栈的周日烤肉留出了一块带骨牛臀肉。

entries.en: The technician spent an hour photographing an akaryocyte in the blood sample.
entries.zh: 技术员花了一个小时拍摄血液样本中的一个无核细胞。

entries.en: The student rejected the alleged akaryote image when a nucleus appeared at higher magnification.
entries.zh: 提高放大倍数后显现出细胞核，学生否定了那张所谓的无核细胞图像。

entries.en: Tiny droplets gathered along the oil-water interface inside the glass tube.
entries.zh: 小液滴聚集在玻璃管内油与水的交界面上。

entries.en: We cannot mess around all morning with the deadline only hours away.
entries.zh: 离截止时间只有几个小时了，我们不能整个上午都在闲混。

entries.en: A white flag appeared above the fort as the soldiers requested a truce.
entries.zh: 士兵们请求停战时，堡垒上方升起了一面白旗。

entries.en: The historian traced how the caste system restricted occupations across generations.
entries.zh: 历史学家追溯了种姓制度如何世代限制人们的职业选择。

entries.en: The film abandons its detective plot line to focus on the missing man's family.
entries.zh: 影片放下了侦探情节线，转而聚焦失踪男子的家人。

entries.en: The young bird's natural ability to navigate amazed the researchers.
entries.zh: 这只幼鸟辨别方向的本能让研究人员惊叹。

entries.en: An akee shaded the courtyard, its bright fruit attracting the photographer's attention.
entries.zh: 一棵阿开木为庭院遮阴，鲜艳的果实吸引了摄影师的注意。

entries.en: The clinical report recorded a brief episode of akinesia during the examination.
entries.zh: 这份临床报告记录了检查期间一次短暂的运动不能发作。

entries.en: The historical notes distinguish akinesis from weakness caused by muscle fatigue.
entries.zh: 这份历史笔记将运动不能与肌肉疲劳引起的无力区分开来。

entries.en: The personnel office sent new employees their training schedules by email.
entries.zh: 人事科通过电子邮件向新员工发送了培训日程。

entries.en: The survey asked swimmers whether they had ever been diagnosed with athlete's foot.
entries.zh: 调查询问游泳者是否曾被诊断出足癣。

entries.meaningZh: 快乐得像在腾云驾雾一般
entries.en: After the scholarship announcement, she described the feeling as walking on air.
entries.zh: 奖学金结果公布后，她形容自己的感觉像是在腾云驾雾般快乐。

entries.en: The sheep began to bunch together as the dog approached the gate.
entries.zh: 那只狗走近大门时，羊群开始挤在一起。

entries.en: The charity collected unwanted office furniture from the building before renovation began.
entries.zh: 慈善机构在翻修开始前从大楼里收走了闲置办公家具。

entries.en: The chemist accidentally drew a ring where the compound's open chain should have appeared.
entries.zh: 化学家误把该化合物本应画成开链的地方画成了环。

entries.en: Light from the window glowed softly through the alabastrine lamp shade.
entries.zh: 窗外的光透过雪花石膏灯罩，柔和地透亮起来。

entries.en: The puppy made an alacritous dash towards the visitor holding its toy.
entries.zh: 小狗活泼而急切地奔向拿着它玩具的访客。

entries.meaningZh: 以服兵役为条件对土地享有的占有权
entries.en: The medieval charter granted the estate under knight's service rather than cash rent.
entries.zh: 这份中世纪特许状以服骑士兵役而非缴纳现金地租为条件授予了这块庄园。

entries.en: Thin slices of star fruit decorated the fruit salad like yellow stars.
entries.zh: 薄薄的杨桃片像黄色星星一样点缀在水果沙拉上。

entries.en: The reliability model gave the generator a life expectancy of fifteen years.
entries.zh: 可靠性模型估计这台发电机的寿命为十五年。

entries.en: The air crew stayed overnight while engineers inspected the aircraft.
entries.zh: 工程师检查飞机期间，机组留下过夜。

entries.en: Our relay team began to pull ahead during the final lap.
entries.zh: 我们的接力队在最后一圈开始取得领先。

entries.en: The old typewriter's space bar stuck whenever she typed too quickly.
entries.zh: 每当她打字太快时，那台旧打字机的空格键就会卡住。

entries.en: Her alalia prevented her from answering aloud, so she pointed to the written choices.
entries.zh: 她不能说话，无法出声回答，便指向写下的选项。

entries.en: An alarum sounded in the corridor, interrupting the scene in the historical drama.
entries.zh: 走廊里响起警报，打断了这部历史剧中的场景。

entries.en: The illustrator enlarged the insect's alary structures to show their delicate veins.
entries.zh: 插画师放大了昆虫的翼状结构，以展示其细密的翅脉。

entries.en: The newspaper reported that the murder charge had been withdrawn after new evidence emerged.
entries.zh: 报纸报道，新证据出现后，谋杀指控已被撤销。

entries.en: The emulator loaded the target program but stopped before its first instruction.
entries.zh: 模拟器加载了目标程序，却在执行第一条指令前停止了。

entries.en: The timber invoice used board measure instead of listing the planks by weight.
entries.zh: 木材发票采用板英尺计量制，而没有按重量列出木板数量。

entries.en: The receptionist asked us to wait in the reception room beside the courtyard.
entries.zh: 接待员请我们在庭院旁的接待室等候。

entries.meaningZh: 未能击倒全部木瓶的一局
entries.en: A missed final pin left him with an open frame in the bowling match.
entries.zh: 最后一个球瓶没有击中，使他在保龄球比赛的这一格未能全倒或补中。

entries.en: A trapped bubble under the cover slip obscured part of the specimen.
entries.zh: 盖片下困住的一个气泡遮住了部分标本。

entries.en: The technician reseated the memory board before restarting the computer.
entries.zh: 技术员重新插好存储器板后，重启了计算机。

entries.en: The historical atlas marked regions where alastrim had once been reported.
entries.zh: 这本历史地图册标出了曾报告过类天花的地区。

entries.en: The students separated alate ants from the wingless workers in the photograph.
entries.zh: 学生们在照片中将有翼蚂蚁与无翼工蚁区分开来。

entries.en: The drawing shows an alated seed drifting away from the parent tree.
entries.zh: 图画展示了一颗有翼种子从母树飘走。

entries.en: The museum combines exhibits on natural science with displays about local industry.
entries.zh: 这家博物馆同时设有自然科学展品和当地工业的展示。

entries.en: The survey compared access to primary care in rural and urban communities.
entries.zh: 这项调查比较了乡村和城市社区获得初级医疗服务的情况。

entries.en: She checked the page numbers before handing in her examination paper.
entries.zh: 她在交考卷前核对了页码。

entries.en: He resisted the siren call of easy profits from an unfamiliar investment scheme.
entries.zh: 他抵住了一个陌生投资计划所许诺的轻松获利的诱惑。

entries.en: The flat had a gas range but no space for a full-sized refrigerator.
entries.zh: 这套公寓配有煤气灶，却没有放置全尺寸冰箱的空间。

entries.en: She speaks her mother tongue with her grandparents and English at university.
entries.zh: 她和祖父母说母语，在大学则说英语。

entries.en: The priest's white alb brushed the steps as he entered the chapel.
entries.zh: 神父走进小礼拜堂时，白色长袍拂过台阶。

entries.en: The albescent sky above the hills signalled that dawn was approaching.
entries.zh: 山丘上方渐渐发白的天空预示着黎明将至。

entries.en: The zoologist compared the albinal animal's markings with those of its siblings.
entries.zh: 动物学家将这只白化病动物的斑纹与其同胞的斑纹作了比较。

entries.en: The children tried to sneak off before anyone assigned them washing-up duties.
entries.zh: 孩子们试图在有人安排他们洗碗之前偷偷溜走。

entries.en: Please do not toss away the envelope before checking the return address.
entries.zh: 请先检查回邮地址，再扔掉信封。

entries.en: A federal agent interviewed the witness about the missing shipment.
entries.zh: 一名联邦探员就失踪货物询问了证人。

entries.en: Every applicant received the same form letter with only the name changed.
entries.zh: 每位申请人都收到了同一封套用信函，只改了姓名。

entries.en: The collection includes a photograph of an albinic deer standing among darker animals.
entries.zh: 这套藏品包括一张白化鹿站在深色动物群中的照片。

entries.en: The biologist recorded the albinotic bird separately because its plumage was unusually pale.
entries.zh: 生物学家单独记录了这只白化病鸟，因为它的羽毛异常浅淡。

entries.en: We should keep our eyes open for fallen branches along the path.
entries.zh: 我们应该留心小路沿途掉落的树枝。

entries.en: The wider view angle allowed the photographer to include both towers.
entries.zh: 更宽的视角使摄影师能将两座塔都拍进画面。

entries.en: The museum catalogue dates this air-to-ground missile to an early experimental programme.
entries.zh: 博物馆目录将这枚空对地导弹归于一项早期试验计划。

entries.en: A surge in imported machinery widened the country's trade deficit during the construction boom.
entries.zh: 建设热潮期间，机械进口激增，扩大了该国的贸易逆差。

entries.en: The stock farmer moved the cattle to a sheltered field before the storm.
entries.zh: 暴风雨来临前，畜牧业者将牛转移到了一块避风的田地。

entries.en: The damaged aircraft had to crash land in an empty field.
entries.zh: 受损飞机不得不在一片空地上迫降。

entries.en: Nobody noticed the unopened letter beneath the napkins on the dinner table.
entries.zh: 没有人注意到餐桌上餐巾下面那封未拆的信。

entries.en: The geologist marked the pale albitic veins on the sample photograph.
entries.zh: 地质学家在样本照片上标出了浅色的钠长石脉。

entries.en: The anatomy illustration labels the albuginea surrounding the testis.
entries.zh: 解剖插图标出了包围睾丸的白膜。

entries.en: Heating caused the albuminous liquid in the test tube to turn cloudy.
entries.zh: 加热使试管内含白蛋白的液体变得浑浊。

entries.en: We folded the rear seats of the estate car to fit the bicycles inside.
entries.zh: 我们放倒旅行车的后座，把自行车装了进去。

entries.en: The museum's long corridor represents geological time from Earth's formation to the present.
entries.zh: 博物馆的长走廊展示了从地球形成至今的地质时间。

entries.en: The chart showed a busy air lane passing north of the island.
entries.zh: 图表显示，一条繁忙的常规航空路线经过岛屿北面。

entries.en: Only her father still called her by the childhood pet name Bunny.
entries.zh: 只有父亲仍用她童年时的爱称“小兔子”称呼她。

entries.en: The catcher adjusted his face mask before crouching behind home plate.
entries.zh: 接球手调整了防护面罩，然后蹲在本垒板后。

entries.en: The child chose Saturn as the major planet for her classroom poster.
entries.zh: 孩子选择土星作为课堂海报中的大行星。

entries.en: The medical institution expanded its outpatient building to serve nearby towns.
entries.zh: 这家医疗机构扩建了门诊楼，为附近城镇提供服务。

entries.en: The study recorded albuminuria as a laboratory finding rather than a reported symptom.
entries.zh: 这项研究将蛋白尿记录为实验室检查发现，而非患者报告的症状。

entries.en: The researchers compared albuminuric samples with samples showing no detectable urinary protein.
entries.zh: 研究人员将蛋白尿样本与未检测到尿蛋白的样本进行了比较。

entries.en: The chemist checked the albuterol label against the inventory record.
entries.zh: 药剂师核对了沙丁胺醇的标签与库存记录。

entries.en: The library adopted a classification system that grouped travel diaries by region.
entries.zh: 图书馆采用了一套按地区归类旅行日记的分类系统。

entries.en: The family bought a quarter section beside the creek and planted wheat.
entries.zh: 这家人在小溪旁买下了一块约一百六十英亩的土地，种上了小麦。

entries.en: The actors began to fool around backstage, imitating each other's solemn speeches.
entries.zh: 演员们开始在后台嬉闹，模仿彼此严肃的演说。

entries.en: A base on balls put another runner on first during the final inning.
entries.zh: 最后一局中，一次四坏球保送又让一名跑者上了一垒。

entries.en: His air castle of owning a tropical island distracted him throughout the bus ride.
entries.zh: 他拥有热带岛屿的空想使他在整个公交行程中都心不在焉。

entries.en: A radio link connected the mountain observatory with the control centre below.
entries.zh: 一条无线电通信线路连接了山顶天文台与山下的控制中心。

entries.en: Two siblings with alcaptonuria contributed samples to the family's genetic study.
entries.zh: 两名患有尿黑酸尿症的同胞为这个家庭的遗传研究提供了样本。

entries.en: The guide pointed out the alcazar's Moorish arches above the Spanish town.
entries.zh: 导游指出了西班牙小镇上方那座城堡的摩尔式拱门。

entries.en: The children argued about team boundaries before starting prisoner's base in the playground.
entries.zh: 孩子们在操场上开始玩抓俘虏游戏前，争论起了双方的界线。

entries.en: The spokesman tried to twist around her remarks to suggest she supported the plan.
entries.zh: 发言人试图曲解她的话，使人以为她支持这项计划。

entries.en: The write-in candidate gained support despite having no printed place on the ballot.
entries.zh: 虽然选票上没有印出姓名，这位选民自填的候选人仍获得了支持。

entries.en: The publisher released a cheaper trade edition after the illustrated collector's version sold out.
entries.zh: 插图收藏版售罄后，出版社推出了价格更低的普通版。

entries.en: The hiking club uses a buddy system so nobody walks alone.
entries.zh: 徒步俱乐部采用伙伴互助制度，让任何人都不独自行走。

entries.meaningZh: 美国在州政府注册的银行
entries.en: The state bank in Ohio submitted its annual report to the state regulator after appointing a new chair.
entries.zh: 这家位于美国俄亥俄州的州立银行任命新董事长后，向州监管机构提交了年度报告。
